note: Estimated new-car loan rates for the website. Method is the app's: starting rate per loan length = the middle (median) of current advertised new-car rates from official lender pages, needing at least 3 lenders; plus Experian's gap between credit ranges. A loan length with fewer than 3 lenders has no estimate and the shopper types a rate.
